chunks.title: Git Tutorial: the commands you use most, with examples — Overview
chunks.text:
Version control is a system that records changes to a file or set of files over time so that you can recall specific versions later. It allows you to revert files or project to a previous version, track modifications and modifying individuals, and compare changes. It is essential for the integrity of the project and the people working on it.

And last but not least, 80% of the time we're just going to use about 20% of the available git commands.

- Use a single branch for all changes.

chunks.title: Unified AI Runtime (UAIRT): one C API, eight backends
chunks.text:
Repo | PyPI

One C API to run compiled AI models on QNN (Qualcomm NPUs), ONNX Runtime, TFLite,
CoreML, llama.cpp (GGUF language models), TensorRT, OpenVINO and NCNN. Write the
application code once; choose the backend by name when you create an engine.

UAIRT loads artifacts that each vendor's toolchain already produced and runs them
through that vendor's runtime. It does not convert or quantize models, and a
device or SDK mismatch returns an error instead of silently falling back to the CPU.

chunks.title: website-kit: a starter kit for proof-of-concept websites
chunks.text:
Repo

A starter kit for spinning up a proof-of-concept website with minimal setup. It has four
modules; each is fully independent, so you use one or any combination and nothing in one
module imports, links to or requires another.

The script copies one module into a fresh directory, installs its CI templates as
.github/workflows/ and makes the first commit. The result has no connection back to the kit.

chunks.title: website-kit: a starter kit for proof-of-concept websites — Modules
chunks.text:
- Cloudflare — Terraform for DNS, zone security, Pages, Workers resources (KV, D1, R2), WAF, Tunnel, Access, Turnstile and Email Routing, each behind an enable_* flag; nine runnable Worker examples (REST API over D1 + KV + R2, cron to queue, Turnstile contact form, Workers AI, Durable Objects, an email-server mailbox and more); a Pages site with Functions; CI templates.
- GitHub Pages — six deployable templates (plain HTML, Jekyll, Hugo, Astro, Vite + React, MkDocs). Each folder is a complete repo with its own workflow.
- WordPress — a Docker stack (WordPress, MariaDB, Mailpit), a one-command WP-CLI bootstrap, a block theme, a core plugin, a hardening mu-plugin, deploy workflows and a static export.
- Apps Script — four clasp projects: a Sheets-backed JSON API, a contact-form backend, a web app UI and a scheduled email digest, with a test harness that runs against fakes of the Google
